title: Expose parallel model jobs and actionable worker controls
goal: Provide existing CLI/API mission and task status surfaces with each job's task/worker/model, redacted credential reference, worktree/branch, claim lease, running/queued/blocked/recovering state, budget/quota usage and outcome. Report actual concurrent workers and why queued jobs cannot start; allow bounded concurrency settings, pause new dispatch, cancellation and supported resume without abandoning running work silently. Never reveal credentials or report partial execution as full success. Hermetic status/control tests exercise multi-model jobs and all-workers-blocked recovery. Implement nonzero tests named parallel_jobs_status_* in the production owning crate.
